summary:
Per-bank counts: Yardeni 4, Goldman 3, Wells Fargo 1 (8 items, 3 banks/strategists).

Yardeni content centers on labor and valuation: accelerating hours worked, a core CPI goods/services breakdown, a fresh all-time high in the assumed long-term earnings growth rate, and the S&P 500 P/E ratio approaching an 18-handle.

Goldman spans manufacturing, inflation, and growth: Empire Manufacturing prices-paid components rising, the core inflation tracker at 2.2%, and a Q3 GDP forecast of +2.5%.

Wells Fargo turned more cautious, cutting its S&P 500 target to 7,700 and flagging 5-10% downside first.

All items sourced same-day (Sept 15) via relay account MikeZaccardi; no cross-account duplicates found.
